memories.content: The user keeps two potted herbs beside a south-facing window.
During a week when the user watered every day based only on the soil surface, the leaves of one plant turned yellow.
During a week when the user checked below the soil surface with a finger before watering, the plant grew new leaves.
On a day the user left the window open for a long time, strong wind knocked over one pot.
The next day, the user moved the pot inward from the windowsill so the same wind would not knock it over.
The user put a plant-name label in a small pot received from their maternal aunt.
The user confused the care instructions for an unlabeled pot with those for another plant.
The user's maternal aunt considers understanding the sunlight at a pot's location more important than watering frequency when caring for it.
Before creating a plant-care reminder, check each plant's name and most recent watering date.
The soil in the user's potted herbs beside the south-facing window dries at different rates depending on the season and amount of sunlight.
The user collects clothes for donation in a large bag beside the entrance.
After emptying an entire drawer at once, the user could not find a charger they needed.
During the next organizing session, the user sorted items by type and put only items to be discarded in the bag.
Even after photographing unworn clothes, the user did not take them out again for one month.
After moving those clothes to the donation bag, the user cleared one closet compartment.
The user nearly discarded an important paper with advertising and checked the recycling box again.
During the next organizing session, the user kept a separate document box and did not mix the papers.
The user's mother asks the user to check whether she needs kitchen items in good condition before discarding them.
Confirm with the user before marking a personal document or another person's property as a disposal candidate.
The local agent cannot determine an object's emotional meaning from frequency of use alone.

analysis.overview: The frames cover separate practical domains: the reference records herb care, location risks, identification, and reminder prerequisites, while the compared frame records decluttering practices, disposal safeguards, and limits on inferring sentimental value. No operational claim materially overlaps or conflicts across the frames.
